tables.name: loan_aging_class_tracking
tables.description: Daily (T-3) loan repayment tracking results for every digital loan customer with active MyMo status, keyed by customer_id/account_number and partitioned by daily_date. Written by the loan_repayment pipeline's Loan Aging Class Tracking Spark step, joining loan tracking (HDFS cleansed csv, loan_origination_tracking) with loan account information (Hive prod_safe_account_information.loan, dv_loan_account) by customer_id and account_number (inner join).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Primary key. Renamed from cif on the loan tracking input during pre-processing.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: Primary key. Carried through from the safe (MD5-hashed) DV loan account table.

columns.name: aging_class
columns.description: 1-5, or Undefined when the source aging_class was null.

columns.name: mymo_user_status
columns.description: C, U, or D. Renamed from data_status on the DV loan (Hive) input.

columns.name: loan_status
columns.description: Derived from account_status and contract age: new (account_status=0, age<1 day), active (account_status=0, age>=1 day), or deactivate (account_status=4).
